title: pellaea articulata
intro: Pellaea articulata, commonly known as the articulated fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, treat skin conditions, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea articulata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe irritated skin and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pellaea articulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
